display.title: The Chofetz Chaim and Guarding Our Words
display.summary_short: A one-minute introduction to the Chofetz Chaim, the great rabbi named after his famous sefer on shmiras halashon, guarding one's tongue.
display.summary_long: A very short clip from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, the opening of a story introduction. Uncle Yossi introduces the great rabbi known as the Chofetz Chaim, who placed special emphasis on shmiras halashon, guarding one's tongue from speaking evil. Of his many cherished sefarim, one became his most famous classic, the sefer Chofetz Chaim, and he came to be called by its name. In it he teaches, among many other lessons, how important it is to be extra careful with every word we say. The clip ends here, before the bow-and-arrow lesson and the story that follow in the full broadcast.
display.lesson: Be extra careful with every word you say.
